Author: WGDevelopment
Name: MogCoach Recorder
Punchline: Records FFXIV combat state to a .mogcap file for post-session coaching.
Description: Samples the object table (positions, headings, cast bars, status timers, job gauge) at a fixed rate and writes a .mogcap capture that the MogCoach analyzer turns into a coaching report. Observe-only: it never sends input to the game and never automates play. Use /mogrec to start and stop recording.
